angle: Unlike overview treatments of trees, this video hand-builds a complete classifier on one toy dataset with every Gini number and every age threshold worked out loud.
angle_detail: Give the core build from [06:46] through [12:22] your first full watch, since the impurity arithmetic and the threshold search there are the transferable skill. Then take [14:05] through [15:37] to see how a new person is routed down the finished tree to a majority-vote leaf. Two pitfalls: entropy is named once and never computed, so Gini is all you get, and pruning plus cross-validation are only promised from [16:05] on, while the captions spell Gini as genie throughout.
